complete_examples.text: One can observe that the maximum failure probabilities are 0.11%, 3.44% and 3.39% for the vertical acceleration of the car body, lateral acceleration of the car body and wheel-rail lateral relative displacement, respectively.

Meanwhile, the lateral acceleration of the car body and wheel-rail lateral relative displacement have a close failure segment over a 5.47–7.38 s time interval that is mainly caused by the lateral motions of the vehicle system.
